This is a stainless steel box used as a part of conveyor machines, so I considered heading 8431 (parts suitable for use solely or principally with machinery of headings 8425–8430) and 8431.39 (parts of conveyors). The relevant subheadings are:
- 8431.39.00: parts of lifting/handling machinery of 8428. Conveyor machines fall under 8428.
- Subheading 8431.39.00 breaks out into 8431.39.0010 (parts of belt conveyors) and 8431.39.0070 (other).

A reject bin on a conveyor is a part of a conveyor, and 8431.39.0070 is the "other" statistical suffix, so I chose it.
